# Health — Evidence

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-health.ac1d1aba"></a>**1. The health unit defines a NestJS module, HealthModule, that imports TerminusModule from @nestjs/terminus and declares HealthController as its only controller, with no providers.**
  [`health.module.ts:6-11`](../health.module.ts#L6-L11)
- <a id="research.backend-src-health.fff874c5"></a>**2. The unit's public entry point, backend/src/health/index.ts, re-exports HealthModule from './health.module.js' and HealthController from './health.controller.js'.**
  [`index.ts:1-2`](../index.ts#L1-L2)
- <a id="research.backend-src-health.a7552656"></a>**3. The root AppModule in backend/src/app.module.ts imports HealthModule from './health/health.module.js' and includes it in its module imports.**
  [`app.module.ts:13-13`](../../app.module.ts#L13-L13)
  [`app.module.ts:33-33`](../../app.module.ts#L33-L33)
- <a id="research.backend-src-health.d9353d7c"></a>**4. HealthController injects HealthCheckService from @nestjs/terminus through its constructor as a private field named health.**
  [`health.controller.ts:13-15`](../health.controller.ts#L13-L15)
- <a id="research.backend-src-health.477a1b9f"></a>**5. HealthController exposes a single GET endpoint, check(), decorated with @HealthCheck(), that delegates to the injected HealthCheckService by calling this.health.check([]) with an empty indicators array and returns Promise<HealthCheckResult>.**
  [`health.controller.ts:17-30`](../health.controller.ts#L17-L30)
- <a id="research.backend-src-health.8c65ecde"></a>**6. HealthController is a NestJS controller mapped to the 'health' route via @Controller('health') and tagged with the Swagger tag 'Health' via @ApiTags('Health').**
  [`health.controller.ts:10-12`](../health.controller.ts#L10-L12)
- <a id="research.backend-src-health.1a874f32"></a>**7. The check endpoint is documented with @ApiOperation summary 'Check health status of all dependencies' and @ApiResponse declarations for status 200 ('Health check passed') and status 503 ('One or more health checks failed').**
  [`health.controller.ts:19-27`](../health.controller.ts#L19-L27)
